breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both periodic and Dirichlet (u=0). The ground truth correctly removed the incompatible Dirichlet condition. The generated specification also correctly removed the erroneous Dirichlet condition, only stating 'Apply periodic boundary conditions for u and u_x', which aligns with the ground truth.
